description: Establishment of the National Commission on Research and Development and its affiliated Office
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-16 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Policy approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2026-06-22 to establish the 'National Commission on Research and Development', recognizing the importance of directing the field of innovation and research towards a novel path to enhance the economic stability and the production capacity. Accordingly, an Expert Committee comprising specialists in the relevant field appointed by the Secretary to the President, has prepared a concept paper to serve as the basis for drafting legal provisions for the establishment of the proposed Commission and its affiliated Office. According to the said concept paper, the National Commission on Research and Development will function as the central body responsible for the strategic direction, coordination, monitoring, and development in research and development system of Sri Lanka. Furthermore, the said concept paper provides recommendations as well for the proposed governance structure, institutional provisions, and implementing procedure, aimed at creating a more efficient national research and development environment. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Hon. President and the Minister of Science and Technology to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill for the establishment of the National Commission on Research and Development and its affiliated Office, based on the aforementioned concept paper, was approved by the Cabinet.
